Segmented AI provider picker with the same provider glyphs used by the model selector. Use when the backend needs the provider/agent axis separate from the concrete model id.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/chat/ModelSelector.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { ProviderSelector } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/chat";
```
